slides.title: Audit log table [[banao]]
slides.code:
CREATE TABLE emp_audit (
  audit_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT,
  emp_id INT,
  action VARCHAR(10),
  old_salary DECIMAL(10,2),
  changed_at TIMESTAMP
);
slides.note: Har UPDATE ya DELETE ka record yahan aake chipak jayega 📌

slides.title: Trigger se karo [[automation]]
slides.code:
CREATE TRIGGER log_update
AFTER UPDATE ON employees
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO emp_audit
  (emp_id, action, old_salary, changed_at)
  VALUES (OLD.id, 'UPDATE', OLD.salary, NOW());
END;
slides.note: MySQL syntax: **OLD** keyword purana data pakadta hai 🎯

slides.title: Trigger ka [[result]]
slides.note: Jaise hi Amit ki salary badli, audit table mein entry ho gayi ⚡

slides.title: Kahan [[kaam]] aata hai?
points: **Debugging**: Kis query ne row kharab ki

slides.wrong: Main table ke andar hi **purana data** update karke overwrite kar do
slides.right: Main table clean rakho, **TRIGGER** se alag audit table mein log karo
slides.why: Overwrite karne se history gayab ho jati hai, audit trail zaroori hai 🕵️
